prompt: You're a world-class motion designer building a Supademo launch video. Research and land our core value and narrative. Scenes should be dynamic and confident: hook in the first second, then distinct beats for product proof and AI. Brand-accurate UI, type, color, and motion. Score the music so every cut, animation hit, and scene change lands on a beat or drop; retimed until synced. Social energy, quick cuts

post.originalText:
Opus 5.5 Max is INSANE + leaves Astra in the dust. Here's the prompt I used to one-shot this video:

"You're a world-class motion designer building a Supademo launch video. Research and land our core value and narrative. Scenes should be dynamic and confident: hook in the first second, then distinct beats for product proof and AI. Brand-accurate UI, type, color, and motion. Score the music so every cut, animation hit, and scene change lands on a beat or drop; retimed until synced. Social energy, quick cuts"
